_about: Published CIE 1931 2-degree (x, y) chromaticity coordinates, for cross-checking only. Copied from the colour-science project file colour/colorimetry/datasets/illuminants/chromaticity_coordinates.py (BSD-3-Clause), which cites CIE 015:2004 and the Wikipedia table "White points of standard illuminants". The CIE publication itself was not fetched.

A.note: CIE standard illuminant A. The fetched file does not state its temperature; 2856 K is the commonly quoted figure and is not sourced here.

D65.note: x, y are the 4-decimal rounding the file uses (as in RGB colourspace literature); the 5-decimal pair is what the file says CIE 015:2004 specifies.
